description: This file defines a report class 'IssueSummary' for generating issue-related analytics, including data retrieval, chart data, and summary metrics within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: IssueSummary
classes.description: Main class for generating issue summary reports, including data processing, chart creation, and summary metrics.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the IssueSummary report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with optional filters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate report components: columns, data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves issue entries and processes rows.

methods.name: get_issues
methods.description: Fetches issue records from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_common_filters
methods.description: Builds common filter criteria for database queries.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Constructs data rows for the report from issue summaries.

methods.name: get_summary_data
methods.description: Aggregates issue data into summary form.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for the issue status chart visualization.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Generates overall issue status counts for the report.
